total assets and risk as the regular termis is established, with the constraints hit rate and transaction
volume limit. Lastly, the optimal daily trading strategy is solved with dynamic programming
method. Final proﬁt is $ 132089.1078 on September 10, 2021.

can resist inﬂation greatly.
